newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring bids mostly lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring bids mostly lower.

text.p: Dark northern spring wheat values were mostly lower in line with weaker CBOT, MGE and KCBT wheat prices.
Movement remained slow and almost nil in many parts of the Northern Plains and Pacific Northwest.
In the Minnesota area, producers are beginning to prepare for the soybean and corn harvest. The crops look "average," one dealer said.
But in several Montana areas, farmers are seeding winter wheat.

One supportive factor for U.S. soft white wheat was news that Pakistan will tender for 200,000 tonnes U.S. grade 2 or better soft white wheat under the export credit guarantee program (GSM-102) for October 10-31 shipment.
That should bring up the basis, an Oregon dealer said.
December MGE spring wheat futures lost 4-1/4 cents to end at $4.06-1/4 a bushel.
